The Hurricanes, led by first year head coach [[Jim Larrañaga]], played their home games at the [[BankUnited Center]] and were members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 20–13 overall, 9–7 in ACC play to finish in a three-way tie for fourth place. They defeated [[2011–12 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Georgia Tech]] in the first round of the [[2012 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before falling to [[2011–12 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] in the quarterfinals. They were invited to the [[2012 National Invitation Tournament|2012 NIT]] where they defeated [[2011–12 Valparaiso Crusaders men's basketball team|Valparaiso]] in the first round before falling to [[2011–12 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]] in the second round. ==Previous season== The Hurricanes finished the 2010–11 season 21–15 overall, 6–10 in ACC play and lost in the
